about: Gate 205 (browser) drives the Puzzles trainer at 320x568, 375x667 and kunal761 at text scales 1, 1.6 and 2.4 (gates/drive/textscale.js multiplies every text element's font-size and px line-height) and asserts the board is inside the viewport, above the tab bar and the same across two settles, after proving the larger text moved the board. NOT COVERED: other screens, the other four of the drill seven, the job's control-row budget from gate 48, a real iOS Larger Text.
